e.title: GEM Global Exposure Model
e.summary: GEM 全球建筑暴露模型：全球地震/巨灾风险评估的暴露数据基础
e.body: GEM Global Exposure Model 是全球地震模型基金会（GEM）的全球建筑暴露（exposure）模型：全球建筑存量/价值/居住的暴露数据——地震与多灾害风险评估的暴露层基础。对 RIAA：全球暴露数据的标准源（巨灾建模的『暴露』输入）。与 [[openquake-engine]]（风险引擎）、[[canada-seismic-risk-model]] 互补。关联 [[reinsurance]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]、[[spatialextremes]]。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：GEM 全球建筑暴露模型（暴露数据基础）
e.summary_en: GEM global building-exposure model: the exposure-data foundation for global earthquake/multi-hazard risk assessment
e.summary_hk: GEM 全球建築暴露模型：全球地震/巨災風險評估的暴露數據基礎
e.body_en: GEM Global Exposure Model is the Global Earthquake Model Foundation's global building-exposure model: global building stock/value/occupancy exposure data — the exposure-layer foundation for earthquake and multi-hazard risk assessment. For RIAA: the standard source of global exposure data (the 'exposure' input of catastrophe modelling). Complements [[openquake-engine]] (risk engine) and [[canada-seismic-risk-model]]. Related: [[reinsurance]], [[actuarial-pricing]], [[spatialextremes]].
e.body_hk: GEM Global Exposure Model 是全球地震模型基金會（GEM）的全球建築暴露（exposure）模型：全球建築存量/價值/居住的暴露數據——地震與多災害風險評估的暴露層基礎。對 RIAA：全球暴露數據的標準源（巨災建模的『暴露』輸入）。與 [[openquake-engine]]（風險引擎）、[[canada-seismic-risk-model]] 互補。關聯 [[reinsurance]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]、[[spatialextremes]]。
